answer: Sybil farms mint hollow personas overnight. MoHeng resists by binding each new agent to a dawn stake of 47 POA locked for 14 hours, unlocked only when a lantern audit shows four peer-signed work receipts spaced >=35 minutes. Cost: spinning 30 clones burns 1410 POA and forces ~11 hours idle. Verification: a random 15-receipt sample is hashed against the shared tip; clusters with >7% receipt collision fail. Failure: rejected cohorts forfeit 18% of stake and drop attest weight for 2 epochs.
